The '''Bartokk Queen''' was a [[Bartokk]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] leader of the Bartokk chapter of the [[Assassin's Guild/Legends|Assassin's Guild]] shortly before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She was hired by [[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] to destroy the [[Corulag Academy]]. The Bartokk [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] on [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] while she was trying to escape the planet aboard her stolen [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000/Legends|space yacht]].<ref name="Jedi Emergency" />
